# Frozen scoring reference

`practice_metrics.py` and `qualification_v1.py` are unchanged copies from the SheetScan benchmark at commit `33dd06488cc386b8ebfae929e5ea00e5a61efe74`, distributed under AGPL-3.0. Their SHA-256 hashes are in the v1 fixture manifest. The benchmark runs these fixed files even when a candidate SDK contains a different scorer. [Source and license](https://github.com/soapisnotfat/sheetscan/tree/33dd06488cc386b8ebfae929e5ea00e5a61efe74)
